Crypto Engine Exported Functions

group CRYPTO_ENGINE_Exported_Functions

Functions

void hw_pke_clock(bool enable)

Enable or disable the PKE hardware clock.

参数:

enable -- [in] Set to true to enable the PKE clock, false to disable.

void hw_pke_init(bool byte_swap_en, bool word_swap_en, uint32_t word_swap_base)

Initialize the PKE hardware module.

参数:

  • byte_swap_en -- [in] Enable byte swap if true.

  • word_swap_en -- [in] Enable word swap if true.

  • word_swap_base -- [in] Base address for word swap.

void hw_ecc_init(uint32_t key_bits, PKE_MODE mode, bool go_to_end_loop, bool RR_mod_n_ready)

Initialize the ECC hardware engine.

参数:

  • key_bits -- [in] Size of the key in bits.

  • mode -- [in] ECC operation mode. See PKE_MODE.

  • go_to_end_loop -- [in] Specify whether to force computation to run to the end.

  • RR_mod_n_ready -- [in] Specify whether RR mod n is ready.

void hw_ecc_set_sub_operand(uint32_t operand_addr, uint32_t *operands, uint32_t byte_len)

Set a single ECC operand to the hardware engine.

参数:

  • operand_addr -- [in] Target hardware register address for the operand.

  • operands -- [in] Pointer to the operand buffer.

  • byte_len -- [in] Size of the operand in bytes.

bool hw_ecc_set_all_operands(ECC_GROUP *grp, uint32_t *e, uint32_t e_byte_size)

Set all operands required for the ECC operation.

参数:

  • grp -- [in] Pointer to the ECC group structure.

  • e -- [in] Pointer to the buffer of scalar or hash value.

  • e_byte_size -- [in] Size of e in bytes.

返回值:

  • true -- Operands are set successfully.

  • false -- Failed to set operands. Please check input parameters.

返回:

true if operands are set successfully, false otherwise.

ERR_CODE hw_ecc_compute(void *result, uint32_t output_addr, uint16_t func_id)

Start the ECC computation and get the result.

参数:

  • result -- [out] Pointer to the result buffer.

  • output_addr -- [in] Output address in hardware for the result.

  • func_id -- [in] Function ID specifying computation type.

返回:

Error code of the ECC computation. 0 for success, others for specific errors.

bool hw_sha256(uint8_t *input, uint32_t byte_len, uint32_t *result, int mode)

Hardware sha256 process.

参数:

  • input -- [in] The addr of input buffer.

  • byte_len -- [in] The size of input buffer, unit is byte.

  • result -- [out] The addr of output buffer.

  • mode -- [in] Use mode for Hardware sha256, HW_SHA256_ACCESS_MODE . If mode is DMA, Channel 3 is used default.

返回值:

  • true -- Hardware sha256 process is successful.

  • false -- Hardware sha256 fails to process. When the parameters are invalid, it can lead to calculation errors. If an error is returned, users need to recheck whether the parameters are valid. Example usage 

    // HW Sha256 test.
bool sha256_test(void)
{
    int input_len = 0;
    uint8_t  *input_buf;
    uint32_t sha256sum[32];

    input_buf = (uint8_t *)TEST_BUF_ADDR;
    input_len = TEST_BUF_SIZE;

    bool ret = hw_sha256(input_buf, input_len, sha256sum, HW_SHA256_CPU_MODE);

    return ret;
}

返回:

Result of Hardware sha256 process.

void hw_sha256_init(void)

Hardware sha256 init.

Example usage 

// HW Sha256 test.
bool sha256_test(void)
{
    int input_len = 0;
    uint8_t  *input_buf;
    uint32_t sha256sum[32];

    uint16_t loop_cnt, remain_size;
    uint8_t *pdata = (uint8_t *)TEST_BUF_ADDR;

    input_len = TEST_BUF_SIZE;
    loop_cnt = input_len / SHA256_BUFFER_SIZE;
    remain_size = input_len % SHA256_BUFFER_SIZE;

    HW_SHA256_CTX hw_sha256_ctx = {NULL};

    hw_sha256_init();

    hw_sha256_start(hw_sha256_ctx, NULL);

    for (i = 0; i < loop_cnt; ++i)
    {
        memcpy(input_buf, pdata, SHA256_BUFFER_SIZE);
        hw_sha256_cpu_update(&hw_sha256_ctx, input_buf, SHA256_BUFFER_SIZE);
        pdata += SHA256_BUFFER_SIZE;
    }

    if (remain_size)
    {
        memcpy(input_buf, pdata, remain_size);
        hw_sha256_cpu_update(&hw_sha256_ctx, input_buf, remain_size);
    }

    hw_sha256_finish(&hw_sha256_ctx, sha256sum);

    return ret;
}

void hw_sha256_start(HW_SHA256_CTX *ctx, uint32_t *iv)

Hardware sha256 start.

Example usage 

// HW Sha256 test.
bool sha256_test(void)
{
    int input_len = 0;
    uint8_t  *input_buf;
    uint32_t sha256sum[32];

    uint8_t *pdata = (uint8_t *)TEST_BUF_ADDR;

    input_len = TEST_BUF_SIZE;
    loop_cnt = input_len / SHA256_BUFFER_SIZE;
    remain_size = input_len % SHA256_BUFFER_SIZE;

    HW_SHA256_CTX hw_sha256_ctx = {NULL};

    hw_sha256_init();

    hw_sha256_start(hw_sha256_ctx, NULL);

    for (i = 0; i < loop_cnt; ++i)
    {
        memcpy(input_buf, pdata, SHA256_BUFFER_SIZE);
        hw_sha256_cpu_update(&hw_sha256_ctx, input_buf, SHA256_BUFFER_SIZE);
        pdata += SHA256_BUFFER_SIZE;
    }

    if (remain_size)
    {
        memcpy(input_buf, pdata, remain_size);
        hw_sha256_cpu_update(&hw_sha256_ctx, input_buf, remain_size);
    }

参数:

  • ctx -- [in] The pointer of Hardware sha256 context.

  • iv -- [in] The pointer of iv for Hardware sha256. In sha256 start process, it should always be NULL.

bool hw_sha256_cpu_update(HW_SHA256_CTX *ctx, uint8_t *input, uint32_t byte_len)

Hardware sha256 cpu update.

Example usage 

// HW Sha256 test.
bool sha256_test(void)
{
    int input_len = 0;
    uint8_t  *input_buf;
    uint32_t sha256sum[32];

    uint16_t loop_cnt, remain_size;
    uint8_t *pdata = (uint8_t *)TEST_BUF_ADDR;

    input_len = TEST_BUF_SIZE;
    loop_cnt = input_len / SHA256_BUFFER_SIZE;
    remain_size = input_len % SHA256_BUFFER_SIZE;

    HW_SHA256_CTX hw_sha256_ctx = {NULL};

    hw_sha256_init();

    hw_sha256_start(hw_sha256_ctx, NULL);

    for (i = 0; i < loop_cnt; ++i)
    {
        memcpy(input_buf, pdata, SHA256_BUFFER_SIZE);
        hw_sha256_cpu_update(&hw_sha256_ctx, input_buf, SHA256_BUFFER_SIZE);
        pdata += SHA256_BUFFER_SIZE;
    }

    if (remain_size)
    {
        memcpy(input_buf, pdata, remain_size);
        hw_sha256_cpu_update(&hw_sha256_ctx, input_buf, remain_size);
    }

    hw_sha256_finish(&hw_sha256_ctx, sha256sum);

    return ret;
}

参数:

  • ctx -- [in] The pointer of Hardware sha256 context.

  • input -- [in] The addr of input buffer.

  • byte_len -- [in] The size of input buffer, unit is byte.

返回值:

  • true -- Hardware sha256 cpu update is successful.

  • false -- Hardware sha256 cpu update fails to process. When the parameters are invalid, it can lead to calculation errors. If an error is returned, users need to recheck whether the parameters are valid.

返回:

Result of Hardware sha256 update.
